name: Zombie Shooter VR: Dead Zone
summary:
Zombie Shooter VR: Dead Zone – Survive the Apocalypse!

Enter a world overrun by the undead in Zombie Shooter VR: Dead Zone! Experience intense first-person shooting, atmospheric horror, and action-packed survival battles in virtual reality.

Explore dangerous environments, take aim at approaching enemies, and fight to stay alive. Every encounter tests your accuracy, reflexes, and ability to react under pressure.

KEY FEATURES

Immersive VR Combat
Experience thrilling FPS action as you aim, fire, and defend
